summary: AI Engineer with years building production LLM systems and RAG pipelines at JudgeService. Shipped end-to-end AI products including a local RAG engine with vector databases and embeddings, and a prompt engineering review response service fine-tuning models with LoRA and QLoRA on AWS. Handled evaluation using golden dataset pipelines and structured extraction for a multi-agent NLP platform (0.98 F1) that contributed to a 20% lift in client retention. Delivered monitored model services handling over 100k reviews a month with 93% published unedited, while mentoring engineers across Docker, CI/CD, and Python.
